quā^drīgātus , a, um, adj. quadrigae,
I.marked or stamped with the figure of a quadriga (a coin), Liv. 22, 58, 4; cf.: “nota argenti fuere bigae, atque quadrigae, et inde bigati et quadrigati dicti,” Plin. 33, 3, 13, § 46 ; Paul. ex Fest. p. 98, 3 Müll.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
